description: Design ADDON 2 for this Rune Sentinel: a substantial ATTACHED RUNEGUARD SHOULDER MANTLE. Change only the exposed upper-right shoulder/back equipment. This must be much bolder than the original small round shoulder cap: ONE broad angular shield-shaped dark-steel PAULDRON that rises 5-6 native pixels above the original shoulder, about 10px wide, tilted with the existing 3/4 south-facing body. Two overlapping steel plates, heavy aged-gold outer rim, one large 3x3 bright teal faceted rune inset in the upper plate. Its LOWER HALF must overlap and cover the original shoulder cap: a broad continuous solid base attached directly to the shoulder, no air gap or thin stem. A gold clasp connects a very short navy mantle under the plate, with only a small fabric edge visible behind the far arm. Do not drape cloth across legs or put a gold stripe across the thighs. Keep native old Tibia 8.60 pixel craft: big coherent shaded clusters, crisp dark outline, no texture noise. A solid wearable armor mass, not a hovering crystal, weapon, flag, pole, wings, feathers or floating object. Exactly preserve original helmet, face, chest, both arms/hands, leg pose and boots. No new skin or extra limb. New silhouette should clearly read as a LARGE ceremonial SHOULDER GUARD physically worn on the same original shoulder, not a hand-held shield. Keep all old body coverage opaque. Native64x64, binary alpha, transparent background; no scaling, text, particles, aura or blurry glow.
